latest_news.headline: Hormuz shipping remains largely halted

latest_news.headline: Israel kills Hezbollah commander in Beirut
latest_news.text: Reuters: Israel said it killed a Hezbollah Radwan commander in the first Beirut strike since the ceasefire; Hezbollah reported 17 operations against Israeli forces in southern Lebanon.

latest_news.headline: Russia continues ceasefire violations, Kyiv says
latest_news.text: Reuters: Zelenskiy said Russia continued violating Kyiv’s ceasefire proposal; Moscow and Kyiv traded accusations around the short war-commemoration pause.

latest_news.headline: Moscow warns diplomats before possible mass strike
latest_news.text: Reuters: Russia warned diplomatic missions in Kyiv to evacuate staff quickly if Moscow carries out a mass strike around Victory Day disruption claims.

latest_news.headline: Baltics seek stronger NATO air defences
latest_news.text: Reuters: Latvia and Lithuania called for stronger NATO air defences after suspected drones crossed from Russia into Latvia and one damaged oil tanks.

latest_news.headline: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan over civilian deaths
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera: Kabul accused Pakistan of killing civilians in a cross-border attack, the latest test of the fragile China-brokered ceasefire.

latest_news.text: AP/IAEA and Reuters-linked reporting continue to show a large 60 percent enriched uranium stockpile and unresolved safeguards/access gaps.
